days.title: The Prophet Isaiah (Sistine Chapel ceiling)
days.alt: Isaiah, in a rose robe and green mantle, sits with one hand raised and a closed book under the other, while a child angel peers over his shoulder.
days.look: Look again at Isaiah’s raised hand as he turns from his book toward the angels. What are you asking heaven to send down into your waiting?
days.license: Artist died 1564; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Tree of Jesse
days.alt: Crowned kings and ancestors sit among the carved, curling branches of a tree, holding sceptres and books.
days.look: Look again at the kings seated among the climbing branches, each one holding something handed down to him. Who handed the faith down to you?
days.license: Anonymous work c. 1500; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Philippe de Champaigne (1602-1674) - The Dream of Saint Joseph - NG6276 - National Gallery.jpg
days.title: The Dream of Saint Joseph
days.alt: Joseph sleeps in his chair with his head on his hand, while an angel floats down beside him and points.
days.look: Look again at Joseph asleep, and at the angel pointing the way. What would it cost you to trust before you can see?
days.license: Artist died 1674; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Angel Appears to Zechariah
days.place: Tornabuoni Chapel, Santa Maria Novella, Florence
days.alt: An angel in a golden robe stands at the altar and speaks to Zechariah in the Temple, who stands on the other side in a red robe.
days.look: Look again at the angel at the altar and the quiet watching crowd. What have you prayed for so long that you have almost stopped asking?
days.license: Artist died 1494; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Bartolomé Esteban Perez Murillo - Annunciation - WGA16375.jpg
days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: The angel Gabriel kneels with one hand raised, and Mary, in blue, crosses her hands on her chest, while a dove and cherubs gather in the light above.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s folded hands and her lowered eyes. What is God asking you to say yes to?
days.license: Artist died 1682; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Visitation
days.alt: Mary, in blue, and Elizabeth embrace in the street, with two women waiting behind them.
days.look: Look again at the two women holding each other close. Whom could you go to see in haste today?
days.license: Artist died 1557; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Sandro Botticelli - Madonna del Magnificat - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Madonna of the Magnificat
days.alt: Mary looks down with a lowered face, her head covered with a striped veil, while hands lift a crown of stars above her.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s lowered face and the crown held above her head. Whom does God lift up that the world passes by?
days.license: Artist died 1510; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Nativity and Naming of St. John the Baptist (SM 878a).png
days.artist: Dutch master after Rogier van der Weyden
days.title: The Birth and Naming of St John the Baptist
days.alt: A woman in dark blue holds the newborn John on a white cloth, while Zechariah, in a green robe, sits beside her writing on a tablet.
days.look: Look again at Zechariah’s tablet and the newborn child held close. What do you need to obey before you can speak freely again?
days.license: Painted c. 1510; released by the Städel Museum with the Public Domain Mark

days.file: Correggio - The Holy Night - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Holy Night
days.alt: In the dark stable a glowing child lies on the straw, lighting Mary’s face and the shepherds kneeling beside her.
days.look: Look again at the light that comes from the child and falls on every face. Where in your life do you most need that dawn?
days.license: Artist died 1534; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
